name: Zoe
title: the Aspect of Twilight

Q.name: Paddle Star!
Q.description: Zoe fires a star that deals increasing damage the further it travels to the first enemy hit and surrounding enemies -- between 50/80/110/140/170 + 2+ (by level) + 0.6×AP to (50/80/110/140/170 + 2+ (by level) + 0.6×AP) × 2.5 magic damage. Zoe can Recast this Ability to redirect the missile to a new position near Zoe.
Q.summary: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.

W.name: Spell Thief
W.description: Passive: Enemies drop spell shards when casting a Summoner Spell or using an Active Item. Specific minions also drop a spell shard when Zoe or a nearby ally kills them. Zoe can pick up this shard to cast that ability once. Passive: When Zoe casts this Ability or any Summoner Spell, she gains 30/40/50/60/70% Move Speed for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. These missiles deal 15/25/35/45/55 + 0.1×AP magic damage each. Active: Cast the Ability from a spell shard Zoe has picked up.
W.summary: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.

E.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
E.description: Zoe dropkicks a bubble that deals 70/110/150/190/230 + 0.45×AP magic damage, lingering as a trap if it hits nothing. The bubble's range is extended when flying over terrain. If either the bubble or trap hits an enemy champion she refreshes 16/19.5/23/26.5/30% of her cooldown. After a delay, the victim falls Asleep and have their Magic Resist reduced by 30% for 2 seconds. Attacks and Ability hits wake them up but deal double damage, up to 70/110/150/190/230 + 0.45×AP true damage.
E.summary: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.

R.name: Portal Jump
R.description: Zoe teleports to a nearby position for 1 second. Afterwards, she teleports back. Zoe can use Abilities and Attack, but can't move during this time.
R.summary: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.

Passive.name: More Sparkles!
Passive.description: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.
Passive.summary: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Long-range burst mage whose Paddle Star deals more damage the farther it travels and whose Sleepy Bubble sets up one-shots. Plays from range and steals summoners.
strengths: E bubble: drowsy then sleep, sets up a kill
W steals summoner spells and item actives
profile.curveNote: Needs E to set up big Q.

E.notes: Drowsy then sleep; damage wakes them.

Passive.notes: Next attack after an ability deals bonus magic damage.

profile.windowAgainst: E down: walk up and all-in; she has little escape.
